newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse stocks higher in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse stocks higher in active trade.

text.p: Most shares listed on the Bucharest bourse rose on Thursday, reflecting strong investor demand, traders said.
Sixteen stocks ended higher, two fell and five remained unchanged. Six stocks had no trade while two firms were suspended pending announcements.

Two independent indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 1.1 and 1.12 percent respectively to 538.6 and 549.81 points. The BIG first-tier index was 1,760.01 points, 0.24 percent down on the previous session.
Investors' interest remained focused on two of the three first-tier listings, with fertliser maker Azomures AZOM BX. and chemical plant Oltchim trading over 2.29 million shares, a broker said.
"Both Azomures and Oltchim have a high liquidity," he said.
Azomures closed 20 lei higher at 1,760 lei due to buying presure and Oltchim OLTC BX. chemical plant closed 30 lei weaker at 1,700 lei.
First-tier pharmaceutical plant Terapia TERA BX. also attracted investors' interest, but stock owners were reluctant to sell at a low price, a broker said. Terapia gained 50 lei to close at 2,850.
Policolor PLCR.BX dye maker remained most active on the second tier, with 307,347 shares traded, of which 150,000 shares in a special trade. It ended 40 lei firmer at 1,830.
